notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Oloro's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Oloro's second ability triggers, holding priority, activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers. Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the Starving Revenant trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
